title: SeedAxisDefinition
description: One axis of a fuzz Template. kind=enum lists discrete values; kind=range steps inclusively from..to; kind=generator names a deterministic generator the runner's PRNG drives. See specs/crosscut/scenario-fuzzing.md §4.

name.description: Axis name. Lexically sorted across an axes array to determine canonical id ordering.

values.description: Required when kind=enum. Each value stringified to canonical-JSON form during scenarioId encoding.

range.description: Required when kind=range. Inclusive endpoints; (to - from) must be a non-negative multiple of step.

generatorRef.description: Required when kind=generator. Format: '<family>:<variant>' e.g. 'string:slug', 'int:positive'. Phase 3 ships string and int families.

count.description: Optional for kind=generator. Number of values to draw per axis (default 1). Each draw uses the same per-axis PRNG substream so order is deterministic.
